claim_summaries.claim: The checked primary literature does not provide a general FPRAS or #P-hardness theorem for c_k(F)=sum_{I,J disjoint, |I|=|J|=k}|det F[I,J]|^2 for arbitrary rational-complex F. Existing exact parity optimization acquires support/witnesses; Pfaffian parity counts apply under a constant-determinant condition; Chen-Liu log-concave coefficient counting excludes the natural both-or-neither parity support.
claim_summaries.scope: Targeted primary-source audit, not exhaustive priority certification

claim_summaries.claim: A coherent hard Gutzwiller projection can take a Slater state outside the pure Gaussian family; the explicit two-site filtered 2-form has nonzero wedge square. Gaussian simulation of mode-resolved occupation branches therefore does not evaluate the aggregate Gutzwiller success norm.
claim_summaries.scope: Exact four-mode algebraic counterexample to Gaussian closure; no complexity lower bound

claim_summaries.claim: The 2026 monitored-FLO source is adjacent: coarse-grained postselection plus feedforward/fixed fusion order yields noncommutative branch operators. Its generic-symbol sequential-memory theorem is not average-case hardness; sampling hardness is conditional on its stated conjecture and anti-concentration.
claim_summaries.scope: Distinct monitored-FLO sampling architecture, not the Gutzwiller norm
